text.p: China's largest mobile phone maker Eastern Communications Co Ltd has decided on a pre-tax dividend for B share holders of 0.175 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the Shanghai Securities News reported on Saturday.
The newspaper said Eastern Communications held its shareholders meeting on Thursday.
The meeting also agreed to a pre-tax dividend of 0.373 yuan per share to state shareholders and 0.048 yuan to holders of its domestic A shares.
Shareholders also approved a series of measures for expanding Eastern Communications business, including the import of technology to produce GSM digital telephones, the newspaper said.
Eastern Communications in March reported a 1996 net profit of 291.618 million yuan, up 14.29 percent from 255.162 million yuan the previous year, based on international accounting standards.
Based on Chinese accounting standards, 1996 net profit was 322.182 million yuan against 262.474 million yuan in 1995.
